title: Trident of the Depths
summary: Water Myrmidon trident with Hiemal Strike and different summon and NPC profiles.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial Versatile trident, 5 ft melee. Hit for 1d6 + 3 one-handed or 1d8 + 3 two-handed Piercing, plus Strength. +3 to attack rolls.
fields.Variants: Summoned or Wild Shape Water Myrmidon version adds 1d6 Cold and uses the +3 profile. The NPC version has no enchantment or Cold rider. Cannot dual-wield it even with Dual Wielder.
fields.Hiemal Strike: Melee Action, no recharge. On a hit deal weapon damage plus 1d10 Cold. DC 13 Constitution save prevents Chilled for 2 turns. Chilled gives Cold vulnerability and Fire resistance, and combining it with Wet produces Frozen.
fields.Availability: Unobtainable in normal play. The Water Myrmidon is Permanently Armed.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
